sections.Profile:
The "Ali-Baba" pinball machine, released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in June 1948, is a single-player, electro-mechanical game designed by Harry Mabs, with artwork by Roy Parker. The machine features six flippers, six passive bumpers, and two kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1948
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Myth and Legend, Wood Rail, Original Theme, Fantasy
